summary: 60-year-old man suffered a leg injury in a sliding fall on Twin Sisters Trail just outside the Rocky Mountain National Park boundary; Rocky Mountain National Park SAR and Larimer County SAR ran a unified command with Rocky Mountain Rescue assisting; sled-litter evacuation through fallen trees and high winds to an ambulance, then to Estes Park Medical Center; 30+ personnel.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park SAR; Larimer County SAR
notes: NPS news release Feb 10, 2017; unified command RMNP SAR + Larimer County SAR, Rocky Mountain Rescue assisting; 30+ personnel; patient taken by ambulance to Estes Park Medical Center; Feb 10, 2017 was a Friday.
